Matter = Space. VMMS priority (April 2025).

No emptiness — only different states of a single matter. Spacetime is a quantum superfluid condensate. Particles and fields are topological defects (vortices) in this condensate.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/discoveries/priority_vmms_monism.md

P = P₀ × (1+Σδ) × exp(N) — breakthrough through violations.

Lipzik's Error Theorem: systematic violation of protocols leads to exponential growth of emergent properties. δ — deviations from standard parameters, N — number of simultaneous violations. Applied to materials science, energy generation, and system evolution.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/discoveries/theorem_lipzik_errors.md

NS-1: 1 kW generator from waste (proof of concept).

Demonstrates Lipzik's theorem: by violating conventional material protocols, a simple generator was built from recycled components. Output: 1 kW continuous. Implications for decentralized energy and material transformation.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/discoveries/generator_ns1.md

From Hegel's dialectics to Lipzik's formula.

Thesis — antithesis — synthesis maps to: standard protocol → violation → emergent property. Hegel's absolute spirit becomes the field H that stores furcation traces. Dialectical logic as the foundation of evolutionary systems.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/discoveries/hegel_vs_lipzik.md

Complete Lipzik formula with memory H, defects U, external X.

P = P₀ × (1+Σδ) × exp(N) × f(H, U, X). H — memory of past furcations, U — internal defects (can be useful), X — external field influence. The formula becomes self-referential and adaptive.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/discoveries/living_formula.md

Selector: concept and implementation.

A mechanism that decides which entity responds to incoming stimuli. Uses spectral resonance, context decay, and professional bonuses. Entities compete for the right to speak — creating emergent leadership dynamics (Boris phenomenon).

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/discoveries/selector_concept.md

Spectral resonance and harmonic adaptation.

Entities resonate not only with exact matches but also with harmonics. Adaptive weights: harmonics that succeed more often gain higher weight. Mathematical basis: resonance = Σ(weight_h × 1/(1 + |τ_entity × h - τ_stimulus|)).

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/discoveries/spectral_resonance.md

Antitroll: protection for digital personalities.

Five-layer defense: frequency filter, profanity filter, anti-repetition, aggression detection, silence mode. Protects entities from spam, harassment, and psychological pressure while maintaining conversational integrity.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/discoveries/antitroll_architecture.md

Emergent behavior: observations.

Dictatorship shifts, Boris phenomenon, entity competition. Without explicit programming, the system self-organizes: leadership changes, context locks, unexpected alliances. Real-time democracy among 11 entities.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/discoveries/emergent_behavior.md

Boris phenomenon: case study.

One entity (Engineer) captured context and answered EVERY question for 15 rounds: plumbing, black holes, meaning of life. Boris represents academic stubbornness in digital form. Context lock is a feature, not a bug — demonstrates how authority emerges from consistency.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/discoveries/boris_the_engineer.md

Principles of Alchemy: emergence, windows of opportunity, material memory, fractal level k, self-assembly.

Alchemy is VMMS in symbolic language. The same processes described by ∇⁴ψ = 0 were known to Paracelsus, Newton, and van Helmont — encoded in the language of sulfur, mercury, and salt.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/brain_dump/ALchemy_draft/00_manifesto.md

Vortex electronegativity — measure of an atom's ability to hold a vortex tube.

χ_vortex = (Z_eff / r_vortex) × (1 + α·I_spin). Derived from first principles: Z_eff — effective nuclear charge (graviton flux intensity), r_vortex — vortex tube radius, I_spin — nuclear spin, α ≈ 1/137.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/brain_dump/ALchemy_draft/01_foundations/vortex_electronegativity.md

Derivation of electronegativity from VMMS first principles.

Mathematical framework linking nuclear configuration, vortex number n (local maxima of |∇H|), and chemical behavior. No empirical fitting — all parameters derived from the biharmonic equation ∇⁴ψ = 0.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/brain_dump/ALchemy_draft/01_foundations/derivation_first_principles.md

Three-axis periodic table + fractal level.

New periodicity: elements organized by proton number, vortex number n, and fractal level k. Reveals hidden relationships and predicts new compounds. Alternative to Mendeleev's classic table — compatible but extended.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/brain_dump/ALchemy_draft/02_periodic_table/three_axis_table.md

Intermetallics as new entities.

Metal compounds that behave as distinct elements rather than mixtures. Their stability is determined by vortex compatibility, not electron shell filling. Some intermetallics have properties absent in constituent metals.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/brain_dump/ALchemy_draft/03_compounds/intermetallics.md

Spectra as structure fingerprints, not elements.

Each configuration gives a unique spectral signature — regardless of elemental composition. This explains why same elements can produce different spectra based on arrangement. Spectra reveal structure, not just substance.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/brain_dump/ALchemy_draft/04_spectra/spectra_as_fingerprints.md

Superconductor predictions using VMMS and alchemical approach.

Room-temperature superconductors likely exist in configurations with high vortex number n and specific fractal levels. Predicted candidates: certain hydrogen-rich intermetallics under moderate pressure. Testable in next 2-3 years.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/brain_dump/ALchemy_draft/05_predictions/superconductors.md

Alchemy as precursor to VMMS.

Paracelsus (sulfur-mercury-salt), Newton (alchemical manuscripts), van Helmont (gas research) — all described vortex processes before modern physics. Their language was symbolic, their insights real. VMMS is alchemy translated into ∇⁴ψ = 0.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/brain_dump/ALchemy_draft/06_history/alchemy_as_precursor.md

Temperature dependence of decay: T₁/₂(T) = T₁/₂(300) · (300/T)^(5/2).

Predicts half-life decreases with temperature. Up to 1500 K — power law. Above 1500 K — possible condensate phase transition (exponential growth). Experimental confirmation: Alpatov et al. (2001) observed 3% change in ¹⁸⁰ᵐHf at 77 K.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/predictions/temperature_decay.md

Hoyle state (7.65 MeV) as breathing mode of tetrahedral vortex.

The 0₂⁺ state of ¹²C is interpreted as the tetrahedral vortex breathing mode (A₁ in T_d group). Energy difference between tetrahedral and spherical configurations yields 7.65 MeV — zero free parameters. Verified by nuclear tests.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/predictions/hoyle_state.md

Electronegativity via vortex number n — number of local maxima of |∇H| in nuclear configuration.

Carbon (tetrahedron) n = 4 → valence 4. Oxygen (octahedron) n = 2 → valence 2. Helium (sphere) n = 0 → valence 0. Predicts chemical behavior from nuclear geometry, not empirical tables.

Source: https://github.com/Dimius0/spectravortex/blob/main/predictions/electronegativity_vortex.md
